urdu transliteration: Baba teri Sakina kaise safar nibhaaye\nKaanton bhara hai rasta kaise qadam badhaaye
english translation text: O FATHER! HOW YOUR SAKINA CAN ENDURE THIS JOURNEY\nTHE WAY IS FULL OF THORNS, THE INNOCENT CANNOT WALK

urdu transliteration: Paidal safar mein Baba dare bhi seh rahi hoon\nZaalim se bas yeh keh do panjon pe na chalaaye
english translation text: IN THIS WALK I AM ALSO ENDURING LASHES/WHIPPINGS\nJUST TELL THE TYRANT DONT MAKE ME CRAWL ON HANDS

urdu transliteration: Rukti hoon thak ke Baba to Shimar maarta hai\nMere chacha se keh do aakar mujhe bachaaye
english translation text: WHENEVER I STOP OUT OF TIREDNESS, SHIMR BEATS ME\nTELL UNCLE (ABBAS) TO COME AND SAVE ME

urdu transliteration: Baba tumhara seena mujh ko nahin mayassar\nAb khaak hai bichhona kis tarah neend aaye
english translation text: O FATHER YOUR CHEST IS NOT THERE FOR ME\nNOW DUST IS NOW MY PLACE OF SLEEP, HOW TO FALL ASLEEP?

urdu transliteration: Tishna labi se meri sookhi hui ragain hain\nShimar-e-laeen dikha kar paani to na bahaaye
Rukhsaar dukh rahe hain kaanon se khoon hai jaari\nShimar-e-laeen se keh do ab haath na uthaye
english translation text: MY CHEEKS ARE HURTING, BLOOD IS COMING OUT FROM MY EARS\nTELL SHIMR THE TYRANT, NOT TO BEAT ME AGAIN

urdu transliteration: Baghi ki mujh ko beti badkaar keh rahe hain\nSadme se teri beti raahon mein mar na jaaye
english translation text: THE DAUGHTER OF REBEL THESE CHARACTERLESS ARE CALLING ME\nYOUR DAUGHTER MAY NOT DIE OUT OF THIS SORROW THROUGHOUT THE JOURNEY

urdu transliteration: Maangi dua Naqi ne mahshar ka jab ho meydan\nUs waqt bhi yeh nauha mere labon pe aaye
english translation text: NAQI (POET) PRAYED, WHEN THERE WOULD BE DAY OF RESURRECTION\nI WOULD BE UTTERING THIS EULOGY AT THAT TIME AS WELL
